items.title: Weighing the Business Case for Quality
items.summary: Most of us want to do great work. Building things of exceptional quality – work that’s beautiful, lovable, fast – is one of life’s great joys. However, the story goes, capitalism doesn’t value quality. Businesses don’t fund software that is lovable.
